title: Experiment winner: semantic core, then mood
description: Interpret the request, check its subject and relationships against descriptions, then rank matching titles by mood and attribute strength. Source facts supplement incomplete descriptions. This pipeline beat all 21 preserved comparators under the fixed margins, guardrails, independent audit and uncertainty checks.
scope: Clear proxy winner on ten interpreted, previously captured requests under independent agent judgments. Four ambiguous requests remain separate. Confirmation reused prior development cases; unseen generalization, live cost/latency and the accepted 30-query human baseline remain unverified. This is a pipeline comparison, not a scoring-only ablation on identical text inputs.
